The SITP was 4780 psig. The well was killed with ppg mud and the perforations were squeezed with 50 sacks cement after laying down the Otis SSTT. The well was permanently abandoned with cement plugs set at 11027, 8703, 8122, 5550, 3625, and 620 feet RKB. The first attempt to cut the wellhead was unsuccessful when the marine pack failed to sever the wellhead.
